news.title: Noble Polymers Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 40.726669 million in funding from Satvat Agro LLP, Akalpya India Investment Trust - Akalpya India Equity Fund and other investors.
news.body: Noble Polymers Limited announced a private placement to issue 2,276,400 fully paid up equity shares at an issue price of INR 5 for the proceeds of INR 11,382,000 and 23,475,735 Convertible Warrants at an issue price of INR 1.25 for the proceeds of INR 29,344,668.75 on May 14, 2026. Transaction involves participation of Mahesh Alabhai Odedra for 2,275,400 shares, Hiren Rambhai Odedra for 1,000 shares, Mahesh Alabhai Odedra for 6,000,000 warrant, Akalpya India Equity Fund for 2,912,650 warrant, Satvat Agro LLP for 2,912,625 warrant and other investors. Transaction is approved by board of directors.  Warrant is exercisable at INR 3.75 within 18 months from the date of allotment of such warrants.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 5 experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Executive Director Bhupendrabhai Raiyani was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2018. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Insufficient board refreshment.
